row:
Life is about building connections, learning lessons, sharing stories and growing. 
Few things connect you and your business to the community like your story. But who really knows it? Have you ever gained an entirely new level of appreciation OR found yourself sharing some incredible story you heard about a local business? “You won’t believe what they did to get here!” “I couldn’t believe how much training they go through!” “That is a family recipe from over 100 years ago!”  That's the power of story.

While Drop In Local is a video marketing and marketing strategy firm, our foundation is built upon building connections for ourselves and those around us (you!). This channel represents our passion not only for local video marketing and marketing & sales strategies, but also a knowledge base where we share ideas, insights, lessons and stories from our friends across the country and around the globe.

Please subscribe to our channel and connect with us. You'll be glad you did.
